What we offerA free web app that separates a band song into 6 parts (vocals, guitar, bass, drums, piano, other) with AI on your device, and mixes them for practice
ContactGitHub Issues

Contact

For questions, bug reports, and suggestions, please open an issue on GitHub Issues. A GitHub account (free) is required.

Issues are public. Do not include personal information, and do not attach songs. If separation fails, the error message, the length and format of the file (for example 4:30, MP3), your browser, and your device are enough.

Disclaimer

  • The separation is done by an AI model and is not perfect: sounds can leak between parts or be lost. We do not guarantee the quality of the separated parts or that the information on this site is correct or complete.
  • Separation needs a lot of memory and processing. On some devices it can be slow or fail, and the device can get warm.
  • Separate only recordings you made or have the rights to use. Publishing or distributing separated parts of other people's songs may infringe copyright. You are responsible for how you use the files.
  • We are not responsible for any loss or damage resulting from the use of this site.
  • Links to other websites are provided for convenience. We are not responsible for their content.
  • The content of this site may be changed or removed, and the service may be stopped, without notice.

Copyright

  • The app's source code is published under the MIT License. The AI model (Demucs htdemucs_6s, MIT License) and the libraries used by the app are listed under Settings → About in the app.
  • The text and images on this site are © 2026 ktkwmr.

Privacy

How this site handles information is described in the privacy policy.

Split a song into 6 parts and practice with your band

Separate vocals, guitar, bass, drums, piano, and other with AI in your browser, then mute or solo each part. Free, no upload, no sign-up.
